Subject: Next steps: Security discovery & Private/VPC options

Hi Alicia — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (from today's discovery):
- Acme Apps is evaluating private hosting options for user-sensitive workloads (payments and PII) — primary asks: VPC deployment, data isolation, and on-prem/air-gapped feasibility.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II status unclear; GDPR obligations for EU customers; potential HIPAA scope for a subset of product data.
- Procurement: security questionnaire and a deployment diagram requested by your security team.

Action items / next steps:
1) Please share the vendor security questionnaire (we can pre-fill and route through our secure intake).
2) We will provide a high-level deployment diagram (VPC and private-hosted variants) and a short note on air-gapped/on-prem support.
3) Monica to draft answers for SOC 2 / GDPR / HIPAA posture and identify evidence we can provide (SOC 2 report, DPIA summary, BAA process).
4) Schedule a technical deep-dive (30–45m) next week with your infra/security and our solutions team to walk the diagram and any network/IP allowlist needs.

Proposed times (PDT): Tue 10/13 9:30–10:15, Tue 10/13 14:00–14:45, Wed 10/14 11:00–11:45 — let me know what works.

Attachments: none yet — will share diagram and draft answers in follow-up.

Thanks again, looking forward to progressing.

--

\Forwarding Alicia's questionnaire and dropping initial notes / suggested answers for the team before the call. See inline.
\On Tue, 13 Oct 2026 at 09:18 AM Alicia Gomez <agomez@acme-apps.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marcus — great summary. Confirming the following:
>
> 1) I've attached our security questionnaire (Acme_Security_QA.xlsx). Ideally we'd like the questionnaire back within 3 business days if possible.
> 2) Our security lead (Tom) also requested a deployment diagram showing: VPC peering/PrivateLink options, whether traffic touches Redwood managed control plane, and on-prem/air-gapped feasibility.
> 3) We do have HIPAA coming up for a pilot dataset — can you confirm whether Redwood supports a BAA and what the timeline is to onboard under one?

Prelim answers / notes:
- SOC 2: Redwood has SOC 2 Type II in place for our hosted control plane; for Private deployments we provide guidance and evidence to support customer audits. We should state expected delivery of SOC 2 artifacts via secure portal once NDA is in place.
- GDPR: We have DPA and processing addenda; for VPC/private we recommend customer-managed keys and region placement in AWS us-west-2 or eu-west-1 per geography.
- HIPAA/BAA: We have an established BAA for Enterprise Private customers — legal kickoff typically 2–4 weeks post-SOW depending on procurement. Note: hosted API may require additional controls; Private is the recommended path for PHI.
- Network/architecture: see attached rough diagram (redwood-private-arch-v1.png). Key points to call out for the call:
  * Control plane separation options (managed vs customer-controlled).
  * Data plane routing: for Private we can keep inference traffic within customer VPCs using VPC peering/Transit Gateway or an on-prem connector for air-gapped deployments.
  * Air-gapped: supported via our on-prem package; customers typically take responsibility for node provisioning and we provide an installer + runbook and offline keys.

Attachments I'm prepping for Alicia: redwood-private-arch-v1.png, a 1-page memo on evidence (redwood-deploy-notes.pdf), and suggested completed questionnaire answers.
\I'll have a completed questionnaire draft by EOD Tue (10/13). Can someone grab Legal to start the BAA thread if Alicia confirms interest?
\- Monica
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
